0022600124.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 3-0 and riding a three-game win streak, host the 1-1 Phoenix Suns. The Thunder are 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West, while the Suns are 8th in the West and 1.5 games back in 2nd place in the Pacific. Out for Oklahoma City are Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh and Thomas Sorber, and day-to-day are Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams and Jaylin Williams; Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (out) and Oso Ighodaro (day-to-day). The two teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won their 2025-26 regular-season series 3-2 and their last meeting, a playoff game on April 27 in Phoenix, 131-122.
